plainLanguage: Where the chest muscle attaches to the arm bone, the attachment is long from top to bottom but very narrow from side to side.
qualifiers: Fourteen specimens in one series. The donors were 51 (SD 14) years old at time of death, range 21 to 70 years, 9 male and 5 female. The first pass stated that donor age and sex were not in the retrieved text; they are stated in the Materials and Methods, and the correction is recorded.
Cadaveric measurement, so it is partially direct for a living lifter, and a mean donor age of 51 years is older than the site audience.

conditions: fresh-frozen whole upper extremities, imaged and then dissected

sourceLinks.locator: Results, footprint dimensions and tendon lengths
Methods and Results, width of the humeral insertion measured in total and by head in eight cadavers

statement: At the humerus the pectoralis major tendon has a tall, narrow footprint, measured in fourteen cadaveric specimens at 75 mm (SD 9) superior-inferior by 7 mm (SD 1) medial-lateral, with the clavicular head tendon shorter than the sternal head tendon.
